independent_pass.summary: The independent pass confirmed PRR-007 and the original PRR-008 trigger fixed, reproduced AUTH_EXPIRED recovery failure, and confirmed the terminal branch cannot perform live reconciliation.

decision.rationale: Cycle 10 closes both previous blockers and all configured checks pass. Approval remains withheld because the documented manual recovery path becomes permanently unavailable after its exact envelope expires (PRR-009), and already-terminal replay verifies only persisted JSON without the promised live resource reconciliation (PRR-010).

summary: Cycle 10 correctly binds the production database principal and removes the application-only rollback shortcut. Two S2 defects remain in that same operator recovery surface: recovery cannot run after the original authorization expires, and terminal replay can return historical ROLLED_BACK without observing reappeared exact-attempt resources.

findings.title: Manual recovery becomes permanently unreachable after envelope expiry
findings.observation: executeManualRollback validates the exact original authorization envelope at recovery wall-clock time before reading the attempt. Envelopes expire within 24 hours, while later authority checks require the persisted attempt to retain that exact envelope ID and SHA, so a replacement envelope cannot recover it.
findings.trigger: Invoke the documented manual recovery command for a persisted FAILED or ROLLING_BACK attempt at or after the original envelope expiresAt.
findings.impact: The recovery entrypoint is permanently unavailable and can leave failed-attempt resources or ingress state unresolved even though controller recovery intentionally validates immutable envelope authority without reusing forward-time authorization.

evidence.description: Changing the existing aggregate-crash recovery fixture to run after expiresAt failed with AUTH_EXPIRED before recovery began.
evidence.reference: scripts/lp05/deploy/manual-rollback.unit.test.ts (temporary review-only timestamp probe; removed after execution)

evidence.description: The manual entrypoint passes now() to verifyDeploymentAuthorizationEnvelope before attempt read; contracts throws AUTH_EXPIRED; later code binds the request to the original envelope.
The runbook documents this command as the idempotent recovery entrypoint for an exact persisted FAILED/ROLLING_BACK attempt.

findings.remediation: For persisted recovery, separate immutable envelope/digest verification from forward authorization-time validity, while continuing to require exact attempt/envelope identity and every existing recovery authority gate.
findings.verification: Add expired-envelope FAILED and ROLLING_BACK manual recovery regressions requiring the same aggregate/terminal behavior, plus mismatched-envelope rejection.

findings.title: Already-terminal manual replay skips promised live reconciliation
findings.observation: The ROLLED_BACK/ROLLBACK_FAILED branch calls a persisted-only resolver that rereads aggregate, reference and terminal JSON. The resolver accepts no Docker runner or environment, so it cannot perform the design- and runbook-promised live lifecycle/resource reconciliation.
findings.trigger: An exact-attempt-owned production or restore resource reappears after a legitimate ROLLED_BACK terminal record, then the operator reruns the documented CLI.
findings.impact: The command returns historical ROLLED_BACK with exact-attempt resources live, giving operators a false terminal recovery result.

evidence.description: A temporary assertion on the committed terminal replay fixture proved that the replay made zero Docker calls (18 before and 18 after), contradicting required live observation.
evidence.reference: scripts/lp05/deploy/manual-rollback.unit.test.ts (temporary review-only call-count assertion; removed after execution)

evidence.description: validateTerminalAttempt calls resolvePersistedTerminalRollbackEvidence with only attempt and evidenceRoot; that resolver performs persisted evidence parsing only.
The accepted design requires replay live lifecycle/reference reconciliation, and the runbook states the manual entrypoint reconciles live resources before returning a terminal attempt.

findings.remediation: Run the same non-mutating persisted-aggregate live reconciliation before returning an already-terminal attempt, then verify aggregate, terminal, application and transition authority without repeating application rollback or deletion.
findings.verification: Add post-terminal production/restore reappearance and preserved-upgrade drift regressions requiring live observation, zero application callbacks/deletes, and rejection rather than stale ROLLED_BACK.
